units.source_text: 源氏昔年营造二条院，备极精美。

en.t: Long ago, Genji built the Nijo estate, making it exquisitely beautiful.

units.source_text: 后又营造六条院，世人赞誉为琼楼玉宇。

en.t: Later he also built the Rokujo estate, which people praised as a palace of jewel-like splendor.

units.source_text: 现在看来，这些院落都是为明石夫人一人的子孙建造的。

en.t: Looking back now, all these residences seem to have been built for the descendants of Lady Akashi alone.

units.source_text: 明石夫人当了许多皇子皇女的保护人，尽心照顾他们。

en.t: Lady Akashi became the guardian of many imperial princes and princesses, caring for them with all her heart.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣对于父亲的每一位夫人如明石、花散里等，都竭诚奉养，

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, served and supported each of his father's ladies, including Akashi and Hanachirusato, with complete devotion,

units.source_text: 一切遵照父亲在世时的旧制，毫无改变，竟同孝养母亲一样。

en.t: following in every way the old arrangements from his father's lifetime, changing nothing at all, just as though he were showing filial care to his own mother.

units.source_text: 但他想道：“如果紫夫人还在世间，我当何等真心地为她效劳！

en.t: Yet he thought, "If Lady Murasaki were still alive, how sincerely I would have served her!

units.source_text: 可惜我对她的特殊的好意，她终于没有机会看到，就此死去！”

en.t: It is a pity that she died without ever having the chance to see the special goodwill I bore toward her!"

units.source_text: 他觉得此事可惜，遗憾无穷，悲叹不已。

en.t: He felt the loss keenly, regretted it without end, and could not stop grieving.
